author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: RFC3986 segment encoding is implemented twice.
findings.consequence: The route resolver and Reader source-info validation can drift if the encoding policy changes, causing canonical Reader URLs to disagree with validated source-info URLs for characters such as !, ', (, ), and *.
findings.evidence: The owned helper at lines 198-203 applies encodeURIComponent plus the RFC3986 replacement for [!'()*]. server/api/reader/resolve/[author]/[title].get.ts lines 7-12 defines encodeRfc3986Segment with the same implementation and uses it for canonicalPath segments on lines 35-42.
findings.recommendation: Use this exported encodeReaderSourceSegment from the route resolver, or move the shared policy to a neutral URL utility imported by both modules.
verification: Searched for encodeReaderSourceSegment and equivalent encoding helpers across server, shared, app, and test paths.

Inspected server/utils/reader-source-info-validation.ts, shared/utils/text-safety.ts, listed direct callers, generated lbapi WorkSourceInfoResponse type boundary, and listed unit tests using read-only commands.
Did not run tests because the review requested read-only inspection and the relevant behavior was verified from current source and named tests.
